create_set_user_activity: set a user's last activity timestamp in Redis with optional custom timestamp and automatic TTL expiration
read_get_user_activity: retrieve a user's last activity timestamp from Redis by user ID, returning None if not found
run_sync_user_activities: synchronize batched user activity timestamps from Redis to the Django database with atomic bulk updates
test_schedule_activity_sync: schedule a background job to sync user activities from Redis to the database when a configurable threshold is reached
refactor_cleanup_redis_data: clean up Redis activity data including individual user keys and batch set entries for given user IDs
